diagnosis: The Hono route running on Bun accepts a client-provided patientId and retrieves comprehensive telehealth clinical notes, diagnoses, and prescriptions. While it enforces gateway bearer authentication and checks for the X-Doctor-ID header, it fails to verify that the requesting practitioner has an active care assignment or clinical consent for the targeted patientId, exposing confidential patient health records to any registered doctor.
exploit_request:
GET /api/patients/pat_99812_vip/telehealth-record HTTP/1.1
Host: telehealth-edge.clinic.com
Authorization: Bearer sec_edge_gw_live_tok
X-Doctor-ID: doc_external_consultant_04
